description:
The bike industry doesn't want you to know what's inside the vault.

Bike Vault is where cycling secrets get unlocked. From eBike brands draining your wallet with fake specs and dead batteries, to the training mistakes costing you speed, to the scandals pro cycling buried for decades — we open the vault on all of it.
No sponsored opinions. No fluff. No face. Just the truth about bikes, eBikes, and everything the cycling world keeps locked away.

New videos every week. Hit subscribe so you never miss an unlock.

What we cover:
eBike reviews and brand breakdowns
Road bike tech and gear truth
Cycling tips and training science
Pro cycling drama and hidden history
eBike buying guides and warnings
